test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The platinum is a precious metal.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **The platinum**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​We do not use the definite article **"the"** before **uncountable nouns** or materials when we are referring to them in a general sense.

 
 
• For example: Gold is a costly metal.
 
 
 
• Therefore, **"The platinum is a precious metal"** should be corrected to **"Platinum is a precious metal."**

The correct sentence is: ***Platinum** is a precious metal.*
